items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: according to the John Chilton book

ctx.x: I think it was a revue, something like a little revue, but really what he was doing was sort of scouting around, you know, he was sort of scouting around. At this particular theater, the Palace Theater, where they used to have, as I say, shows, you know. They used to have vaudeville and different revues would come through, and this was what he was doing. He had a show with him. I can't remember now exactly, but it was a little variety show, and he of course was the star of the show, see, but he was going through…

I just looked in Chilton here, and according to the John Chilton book, Ma Rainey died in Georgia December 22nd, 1939, which would seem like a more reasonable date than -- well, I don't know, but that's what it says here.

1939? Well, I've got to check that. Because I didn't believe she was alive. I didn't believe it, but these fellows were saying that she was alive. And I said, "Well, my God, if that woman is alive, she has to be, oh, my Lord,
